messages:
marie: Heads-up — third-party security assessment incoming Thursday 2026-02-26 09:00 PT. We need to finalize RBAC change window, KMS access plan, and audit log exports by EOD tomorrow.

devon: Thanks. Do we have a proposed maintenance window?

marie: Thinking 02:00–04:00 PT to minimize customer impact. Asking for ephemeral assessor roles + read-only access to KMS metadata and audit logs.

aj: Ephemeral roles + session duration ok. Need exact IAM role ARNs and scope. Also: confirm which KMS keys they need decrypt vs. just metadata.

marie: They'll need to decrypt a small set of test payloads for evidence validation. Keys: projects/redwood/keys/ingest-test and projects/redwood/keys/metrics-anon. I can redact exact ARNs in public docs.

lia: Oncall note — if we open KMS decrypt, we need a rollback playbook and realtime alerting to PagerDuty. Also enable higher-fidelity audit retention for that window.

samir: For the vuln triage side — I'll own triage during the window. Would like a consolidated findings channel and a CSV export of issues post-run.

devon: For audit logs, can we export a sliced view: only KMS:Decrypt, kms:Encrypt, iam:AssumeRole, and k8s:exec events? Size should be manageable.

marie: Yes. Can we set retention to 90 days for that slice and generate a presigned S3 bundle after the run?

aj: Yep. Workflow I suggest:
1) Create ephemeral assessor role with MFA enforced and limited session length (4h).
2) Grant kms:Decrypt on two keys for that role.
3) Enable audit-stream filter for KMS/AssumeRole/k8s exec and ship to secure-s3/enclave/pt-buckets/<thread_ts>.
4) Run dry-run 24h before to validate logs and presigned export.

marie: Dry-run scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT. Can you run the dry-run script and paste results?

pen-test-bot: deploy job started — dry-run-kms-audit-check (job id: 20260225-dry-001). Logs: https://ci.redwood.test/jobs/20260225-dry-001

devon: Dry-run logs look good. Found two missing k8s exec events for staging-03 due to service account rotation. I pushed a quick fix to log-forwarder.

samir: Good catch. That gap would have blinded triage on a narrow path. Re-run the dry-run after fix?

aj: Re-run kicked off. Also added an allowlist for assessor IPs in the S3 bucket policy + object lock disabled.

pen-test-bot: dry-run recheck complete — all expected event types present. Archive size ~120MB, includes kms event sample.

lia: Two operational requests before we go live: 1) PagerDuty escalation path confirmed? (yes, oncall rotation has sec-oncall), 2) Runbook link?

marie: PagerDuty: sec-oncall -> eng-sre -> infra-leads. Runbook: https://docs.internal/redwood/sec/pt-runbook (private). I'll update with KMS rollback steps: revoke assessor role and rotate key policy if anything suspicious.

samir: Triage format: use this thread for high-level notes and create a CSV in /shared/pt-results/<thread_ts>/findings.csv with columns: id,severity,component,summary,owner,status. I'll take ownership of population.

aj: Checklist for actual window:
- create ephemeral role (ARN posted in channel)
- enable filtered audit stream + presigned export
- grant kms:Decrypt on test keys only
- monitor logs for any anomalous decrypt counts
- if anomaly -> revoke role + rotate key policy + notify PD

marie: All agreed. I'll post the ARNs and assessor contact info 1h before the window. Thanks team — tagging @lia for oncall readiness. :thumbsup:

lia: Ready. Will monitor and escalate as needed.

devon: After run, let's schedule a 30m retrospective and confirm remediation tickets created for any findings.

marie: Scheduled: retrospective Friday 11:30 PT. Samir will own the findings CSV and ticket creation.

samir: Will do. If anyone sees anything odd in logs during the run, ping me directly.

marie: Closing checklist for now. Re-open thread if plans change. :white_check_mark:
